The emulator's Android Keystore is software-backed, so the key protection of the stored tokens is not hardware-backed there.
Re-consent asks for the OTP again: eSignet Go keeps no browser session. Health Card's explainer screen says so.
The server's runtime store is in memory, so an eSignet restart ends every Hub session; the e2e suite uses this to test the ended session.
A server-side session record ends only by its time to live: there is no revoke call. Hub's sign-out deletes its DPoP key, which stops every token and device secret bound to it.
The GitHub Actions workflow .github/workflows/ci.yml has never run: nothing was pushed, so no hosted run exists. Its jobs are NOT RUN until the first run is seen.
